title: Shady Jewellers
story: In the heart of the glittering city, 'Shady Jewellers' housed the world's most valuable collection of diamonds. On a moonlit night, the owner, Benjamin Tate, discovered a ruthless breach, leaving him heartbroken. His trusted employee, Miranda, managed the security system while glamorous thief, Gatsby, masterminded the dazzling heist. Wealthy art collector, James, and charismatic con-artist, Max, were involved too.
crimeScene: The crime scene was illuminated by an eerie blue light, casting shadows of the gleaming diamonds on the wall. A broken security camera and a smashed vault door revealed the cunning heist.
forensicClue: A peculiar blue dye was found on the security camera lens.
question: Who is the culprit and how did the detective crack the case? (answer below)
options: Option A (Miranda and her familiarity with security system)
Option B (Gatsby and the blue dye)
Option C (James and the jewel-theft history)
Option D (Max and the broken vault door clue)
deductionExplanation:
The detective analyzed the evidence meticulously: the broken vault door implicates James for the theft as he has a history of jewel heists. The peculiar blue dye on the security camera lens suggests Gatsby's involvement, as only he had the motive and knowledge to leave the dye as a signature.

The smashed security camera implies Max's role as the muscle, and Miranda's familiarity with the system could have been exploited by Gatsby to bypass the security measures.
